name: @monark/genkan
description: MONARK Genkan: an order gate whose decisions come from a Lean kernel (mode 1 judges an order under a context, with its theorems); this package holds the kernel, the frames of the gate, its pinned-toolchain wrapper, its source and axiom audit, the writer of its axiom records and the replay of its modules by the toolchain's leanchecker, with Node built-ins only.
